articles.title: Microsoft says services fully restored after global outage hits governments
articles.summary: Tech company says operations restored to all customers and regions affected by one of worst IT failures in years. Microsoft has said its service has been fully restored after a massive outage that resulted in widespread disruption to governments, businesses and public services around the world. The…
